title: USF-172 Analytics Event-Store Provider Disposition Matrix

humanDecision.summary: Analytics/event-store decision is not completion evidence. USF-172 records a bounded disposition gate, USF-197 records the ClickHouse proof boundary, and USF-206 proves bounded local Compose ClickHouse analytics event-store semantics. This does not claim analytics readiness, event-store readiness, live provider readiness, environment promotion readiness, full dev readiness, full React parity, or USF-133 closure.

analyticsEventStoreDisposition.riskStatement: ClickHouse local Compose proof could be overclaimed as analytics readiness, event-store readiness, environment promotion readiness, live/provider-managed ClickHouse compatibility, API runtime analytics binding, or worker runtime analytics binding.
analyticsEventStoreDisposition.treatment: prove bounded local SDK-backed ClickHouse event ingestion, tenant-safe query, aggregation, retention cleanup, unavailable fail-closed behaviour, and redacted evidence while preserving stronger non-claims
provenEvidence: official ClickHouse JS SDK/client selection and adapter boundary evidence
retention deletion and cleanup boundary evidence
audit event evidence for analytics operations
readiness retry, timeout, teardown, and failure-mode evidence
supplier, secret, privacy, incident, and vulnerability posture evidence
remainingBoundaries: live/provider-managed ClickHouse supplier and credential evidence
production alerting and operator access readiness evidence

inMemorySubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: USF-206 proves ClickHouse local Compose provider behaviour directly. Deterministic in-memory analytics or event evidence remains non-equivalent and may be used only where the relevant proof row permits hermetic local behaviour.
scopeCovered: repository records ClickHouse as profile-gated bounded local Compose proof
runtime provider manifest records ClickHouse profile-gated proof with composed-test provider mode
provider registry records analytics-store-clickhouse-composed-test with redacted endpoint ref
validator rejects in-memory equivalence and readiness overclaim
enterprise evidence rows record tenant, retention, audit, privacy, supplier, incident, SDK, and non-claim boundaries
limits: no API or worker runtime use of ClickHouse
no backup, restore, DR, or production alerting readiness
no analytics readiness or event-store readiness claim
no provider compatibility or live ClickHouse certification claim

providerBoundary.providerRegistryEvidence: packages/core/src/index.ts records analytics-store-clickhouse-composed-test as bounded local Compose proof and analytics-store-clickhouse-deferred as the non-live stronger-readiness boundary.
